security_audit.summary: Four findings involve genuine execution of a floating external npm package; eleven findings are unsupported matches involving documentation, standard paths, or readable Korean text. A separate trust issue promotes remotely downloaded output to primary skill instructions, beyond the reviewed files. No evidence of credential theft or deliberate data exfiltration was found in the supplied sources; external dependency implementations were not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Bootstrap commands execute a floating npm major version without an exact reviewed release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an exact reviewed package version, verify package provenance, and obtain user approval before downloading or executing external dependencies.

remediation.issue: Downloaded CLI output is designated as primary instructions outside the audited source snapshot.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle versioned instructions with the skill. Treat remote output as untrusted data and require review before adopting changed instructions.

remediation.issue: The update command targets every coding-agent skill installation, beyond KakaoTalk search.
remediation.suggestion: Remove global updating from the search workflow. Require separate approval for updates and clearly list affected installations.

content.value_statement: Finding past KakaoTalk discussions can require more than remembering exact words. This skill guides katok archive synchronization, local search, and explicit context retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Check katok readiness and archive freshness without the default diagnostic probing macOS application data.
Open macOS permission settings and run explicit source diagnostics when needed.
Synchronize local KakaoTalk conversations through the katok macOS source adapter.
Build or refresh a semantic index using the default local EmbeddingGemma model.
Select keyword, BM25, or semantic search and summarize snippets with chunk identifiers.
Retrieve a user-requested chunk, neighboring context, or its semantic parent window.
limitations: The supported live workflow requires Apple Silicon macOS, KakaoTalk for Mac, and the separately installed katok CLI.
Local ingestion requires Full Disk Access for the terminal; explicit source diagnostics can trigger macOS permission prompts.
The skill does not send or delete messages, automate KakaoTalk UI, or directly handle databases, authentication caches, or decryption material.
Search coverage depends on synchronization and index freshness; external package implementations are outside this source audit.

best_practices: Search only local conversations you are authorized to access, and review external dependencies before installation or execution.
Check freshness before time-sensitive searches, and refresh the semantic index after relevant synchronization.
Start with snippets and chunk identifiers; retrieve full context only after an explicit user request.
anti_patterns: Using direct database access or handling authentication caches instead of the documented katok interface.
Treating an outdated archive or semantic index as a complete record of recent conversations.
Automatically executing global updates or accepting downloaded instructions without reviewing their scope and source.

faq.question: Which computers are supported?
faq.answer: The documented live workflow targets Apple Silicon Macs running macOS with KakaoTalk for Mac installed.

faq.question: What must I install?
faq.answer: Install katok through Homebrew or Cargo. The separate instruction bootstrap uses npx and requires Node.js 18 or later.

faq.question: Why does the terminal need Full Disk Access?
faq.answer: The katok macOS source adapter needs access to local KakaoTalk application data for ingestion. You grant this permission through macOS settings.

faq.question: Can it send or delete KakaoTalk messages?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow only synchronizes local archives, searches them, and retrieves requested conversation chunks.

faq.question: Does semantic search require a remote embedding service?
faq.answer: The documented default uses local EmbeddingGemma. The live workflow explicitly excludes remote embedding endpoints.

faq.question: Were the downloaded tools included in this audit?
faq.answer: No. This audit reviewed the supplied skill files, not external npm or katok implementations. Review dependencies before granting access to private conversations.
